description: Add a deterministic integrity layer for long-hold bitcoin treasury workflows, including reconciliation checks, transfer-pair validation, cost-basis continuity checks, and a composable health score.

timing.gatingCondition: Proceed after Feature-14 completion and after confirming baseline import/parser stability.

principles: Trust Through Verification - prioritize ledger correctness before adding new analytics
Deterministic Output - integrity checks must produce repeatable results from identical inputs
Operator First - findings should be actionable for a single primary user
Fail Loudly, Never Silently - classify and surface integrity risks clearly
Incremental Delivery - ship checks in narrow stories with measurable confidence gains

techStack.reporting: JSON/CSV export with optional markdown summary

userStories.title: Ledger reconciliation engine
acceptanceCriteria: Add reconciliation service that computes expected vs observed balances by coin and wallet over a selected date range
Support deterministic reconciliation snapshots with timestamped metadata
Expose reconciliation output through a typed result object consumable by CLI and TUI

userStories.title: Transfer-pair integrity checks
acceptanceCriteria: Detect likely broken internal transfers (one-sided withdrawal/deposit, amount mismatch, fee anomaly)
Return severity tiers for each finding (info, warning, critical)
Allow configurable tolerances for timing and amount matching

userStories.title: Cost-basis continuity monitor
acceptanceCriteria: Identify holdings/lots with missing or ambiguous cost basis
Summarize impacted coins, wallets, and dates
Generate remediation hints tied to import sources or transaction classes

userStories.title: Treasury health score and policy thresholds
acceptanceCriteria: Produce a weighted health score with sub-scores for reconciliation, transfer integrity, and basis continuity
Persist score snapshots for trend tracking

userStories.title: Integrity CLI report and planning closeout
acceptanceCriteria: Add canonical CLI command to run integrity checks and export JSON/CSV reports
Include concise terminal summary with top issues and remediation counts
Update planning metadata and progress artifacts with feature learnings

high: False positives in transfer matching could reduce trust in integrity output
Performance regressions on large ledgers if reconciliation is not query-efficient
medium: Differences between SQLite and PostgreSQL behavior in timestamp comparisons
Unclear severity tuning may lead to alert fatigue
low: Reporting/export surfaces can be layered on existing query abstractions
Most logic can be validated with deterministic fixture-led tests

preFlightChecklist: Confirm naming and command surface are canonical-only
Define initial threshold defaults for health score severity
Prepare fixture datasets covering transfers, fees, and basis gaps
Document expected runtime on representative ledger sizes
